job_summary: We are seeking an experienced Senior Sales Automation Engineer to build and scale mission-critical internal automation platforms that support sales, marketing, customer operations, and business intelligence. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys building production systems from the ground up, integrating complex third-party platforms, and owning projects from architecture through deployment. You'll work closely with engineering and business leadership to automate workflows, improve operational efficiency, and develop AI-powered customer engagement solutions.
key_responsibilities: Design and build automated customer communication workflows using SMS and email.
Develop self-service scheduling solutions with support for crew capacity, travel time, job duration, reminders, cancellations, and rescheduling.
Build real-time operational dashboards to monitor installation pipelines and business performance.
Integrate scheduling systems with internal business platforms and APIs.
Implement end-to-end marketing attribution using UTM tracking.
Configure Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Tag Manager (GTM).
Build dashboards for Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), campaign performance, and marketing analytics.
Develop internal tools for QR code and short URL generation.
Automate weekly reporting to business stakeholders.
Develop AI-powered customer support chatbot solutions.
Expand AI knowledge base and improve customer self-service experiences.
Build analytics dashboards for customer interactions, call metrics, sentiment analysis, and performance tracking.
Design data pipelines for AI-generated summaries and reporting.
Integrate AI platforms with CRM and internal business systems.

Contribute to and gradually own automation initiatives across AI Voice Agents, Internal Softphone & Dialer Applications, Customer Support Dashboards, Sales Pipeline Automation, Financial Process Automation, Data Lake Integrations, and Infrastructure Automation using Terraform and AWS.
tech_stack: AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, IAM, CloudWatch)

experience: Experience building production systems from the ground up
